name: tutti
summary: One phone remote for a Sony BRAVIA TV and Theatre Bar, the whole living room on one screen.
what: An Android remote for one living room: a Sony BRAVIA TV on Google TV and a BRAVIA Theatre Bar, plus the computer shown on the TV. Touchpad or D-pad, a live keyboard, voice, the soundbar's volume and sound modes, and scenes that set the input, picture mode and a volume cap in one tap. Built to replace BRAVIA Connect for everyday use.
who: Anyone with a BRAVIA TV on Google TV and a Theatre Bar who wants one remote for both.

facts.label: Works with
facts.value: BRAVIA TVs on Google TV and BRAVIA Theatre Bars

facts.label: Account
facts.value: None, no Sony account and no cloud

facts.label: Get it
facts.value: APK on GitHub Releases, F-Droid coming

flow.label: The remote, scenes and widgets
flow.note: Jetpack Compose and Material 3, with a Glance widget, a Quick Settings tile and a media notification

flow.label: Talking to the TV
flow.note: the Android TV Remote v2 protocol over TLS, paired once with a code shown on the TV, plus Sony's IP control for picture and inputs

flow.label: Talking to the Theatre Bar
flow.note: the bar's IP control over TCP, for volume, sound field, night mode, bass and rear level

decisions: Local protocols only: it speaks Sony's and Google TV's own protocols on the LAN, so there is no account, no cloud and nothing to sign in to.
Devices are pinned on first use, and pairing material is encrypted with an Android Keystore key.
A pure Kotlin protocol module with a device simulator, so the wire formats and state machines are tested without a TV.
Setup, room calibration and speaker placement stay in BRAVIA Connect, which tutti opens when you need it.
